title: Overnight specialist report
description: The report a /dev-overnight Step 3 specialist writes, docs/dev/overnight/<session_id>/<specialist>-report.json, in the shape its own agent file declares; G2 checks it at the specialist's own stop. PM TRIAGE reads its findings: the issues array (agents/architect.md, product-owner.md, user.md), each issue carrying what triage merges and the pipelines carry, with no issue repeated; or the canonical finding channels of skills/ui-shared/report-schema.json (agents/ui-specialist.md). task_id is the identity the obligation names. Every other field is allowed.
